items.title: Charlie De Vore Interview, 1962-07-04
items.q: I remember I heard Raymond play with the most horrible band once

ctx.x: What about the sense of meter, Charlie? How do you get at that?

Well, the meter in music, that's in all kinds of music. That's something, if a guy hasn't got a sense of meter, he can't play. It's impossible. And I think that goes along with a guy's either got an ear for music or he hasn't. There's plenty of people that just don't have an ear for music. I mean, you sing something to them and they try and sing it back, they can't. And this is a physical defect more than anything else. And meter is right along with it. Like, well, when you're singing, he wouldn't say, you tell…
But how do guys learn? Say, you know, you've got a young guy here and he doesn't, he's never thought about meter maybe and he wants to play New Orleans music.
